limits: The evaluation pool mixes many held-out partners, so the rank correlation is computed on that mixture.
Retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI.

the_science.reading: starvation worked - identity fell by 31 percent - but the pathway prior fell by almost exactly as much, so the gap did not move. The pathway gain is flat at 0.029 to 0.036 across a tenfold reduction in the visible drug's training rows.
the_science.verdict: the pathway gain does not depend on how much data the visible drug has

what_this_sharpens.the_condition_is_qualitative_not_quantit: put together with the both-unseen result, the value of the pathway prior is governed by whether identity is available at all, not by how much of it there is. It behaves as a step function rather than a gradient.
what_this_sharpens.why_this_is_useful: it tells a practitioner not to bother estimating the visible drug's sample size before deciding whether to use the annotation; the question is simply whether the drug was seen
what_this_sharpens.consistency: this agrees with C103, where the gain was near zero with identity fully available and large when it was absent, with the intermediate cases in between

a_tool_limitation_this_round_exposed.what_happened: the preflight audit flagged every held-out drug's one-hot column as CONSTANT_ON_EVAL, in all four arms
a_tool_limitation_this_round_exposed.is_it_a_real_defect: no. A held-out drug's identity column is all zeros on evaluation by construction - that is precisely what an unseen drug means. The flag is correct about the data and wrong about the intent.
a_tool_limitation_this_round_exposed.consequence: the audit will flag EVERY substitution experiment, because holding out a categorical level always makes its columns constant
a_tool_limitation_this_round_exposed.needed: the audit needs a way to declare blocks that are intentionally uninformative, so that real alarms are not buried under expected ones
a_tool_limitation_this_round_exposed.status: recorded as a limitation; not fixed this round
